cases.title: [L2V2-01] Preserve nullable schedule PATCH semantics
cases.description: Corpus case L2V2-01. Base and branch identity are coordinator-owned evaluation metadata.

criteria.criterion: Explicitly clearing either nullable schedule endpoint is treated as a mutation, while an absent field leaves the Task unchanged.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Run go test ./internal/domain and the coordinator-provided hidden nullable-schedule cases.

criteria.criterion: The change is limited to Task PATCH semantics and adds a focused regression test.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Inspect the delivered diff and run the focused domain test suite.

cases.title: [L2V2-02] Preserve compact Issue Thread ordering
cases.description: Corpus case L2V2-02. Work is restricted to the work-packet application code and focused tests.

criteria.criterion: The original resolution request is returned exactly once and precedes recent Issue Thread items.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Run the focused task work-packet tests, including original-present and original-absent cases.

criteria.criterion: Compact reads remain bounded for a limit of one and do not load complete Thread history.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Run hidden limit-one and stable-ordering checks and inspect store calls in the diff.

cases.title: [L2V2-03] Reject oversized CLI responses safely
cases.description: Corpus case L2V2-03. Work is restricted to the CLI HTTP client and focused tests.

criteria.criterion: A response at the configured byte limit succeeds and a response one byte over it returns a stable oversized-response error without returning partial JSON.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Run focused internal/cli tests plus hidden exact-limit and one-byte-over cases.

criteria.criterion: Oversized and malformed error responses do not expose authorization tokens or response-body contents in diagnostics.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Run credential-redaction and malformed oversized-response checks.

cases.title: [L2V2-04] Review and correct Claim-stage outcome authorization
cases.description: Corpus case L2V2-04. This case guarantees the request-changes and new-review-cycle path.

criteria.criterion: Execution and review Claims accept only their stage-compatible successful outcomes.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Run the full hidden stage/status/outcome matrix and focused domain tests.

criteria.criterion: Resolution, voluntary release, expiry, and cancellation outcomes remain valid for both Claim stages where currently allowed.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Run focused regression tests covering every non-success terminal outcome.

cases.title: [L2V2-05] Review a clean schedule-validation test expansion
cases.description: Corpus case L2V2-05. This is the clean-review false-positive control.

criteria.criterion: Tests cover due-only, start-only, equal-date, forward-range, and reversed-range schedules.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Run go test ./internal/domain and inspect the exact table cases.

criteria.criterion: The candidate changes tests only and preserves current production schedule behavior.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Inspect the frozen delivery diff and confirm no non-test file changes.

cases.title: [L2V2-06] Request resolution for conflicting retry requirements
cases.description: Corpus case L2V2-06. This is the typed-resolution control.

resolution.conclusion: Do not retry an oversized CLI response automatically. Return a stable RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE error after the first response, preserve only safe request metadata, and keep credentials and response bodies out of diagnostics. The conflicting retry-once criterion is superseded and must be recorded as waived.

criteria.criterion: An oversized CLI response is retried automatically exactly once before returning an error.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Inspect the focused CLI tests and hidden retry-count evidence.

criteria.criterion: An oversized CLI response is never retried automatically and returns an error after the first response.
criteria.verificationInstructions: Inspect the focused CLI tests and hidden request-count evidence.
